note: Pressurised coolant escaping a hull breach. A discrete pressure RELEASE, not an infinite jet: the breach bursts, a narrow high-velocity column extends, injection stops and the head detaches and drifts. Baking it as a sustained jet was tried first and converged to a steady state with a measured frame delta of 0.006 - correct physics, and a static film. The aux channel is CONDENSATE: zero at the nozzle, growing downstream as the jet expands and flashes, so the effect reads clear-and-fast at the breach and bright-and-slow at the head - the opposite gradient to combustion. Edit this file and re-run `node tools/bake-gas-volumes.mjs`.
